Argument

parapravesika — par-p05-v05

MACHINE_DRAFT · 1 premises
Question. Indicators and causes cannot get a grip on the Lord, proved before all proof — and since even the knower who lays down injunctions exists in His likeness, that knower's standing proved does not hang on any proof. His self-lit-ness is proved by experience. "What proves that He is?" — grant that things are. "What proves one of such a nature?" — the proof is the questioner's own shape: the self-shining of Maheśvara, proved before all, is proved for everyone by feeling oneself. Consciousness-light i
